subject: Model evaluation package & NDCG/MRR A/B runbook
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@marketplaceai.com>, Mark Weller <mark.weller@marketplaceai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Model evaluation package & NDCG/MRR A/B runbook

Hi Priya / Mark — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the evaluation package we discussed so your engineering and ML teams can review. I attached the prompt sets and a short brief; links below.

Summary of goals (from discovery)
- Primary: Improve ranking quality for MarketplaceAI search results (NDCG@10 uplift goal >= +4.5% absolute).
- Secondary: Preserve or improve MRR for logged-in users; keep 95th %-tile latency < 220ms for the online reranker.
- Constraint: Budget target ~<$0.15 per 1k queries for the rerank phase.

Initial model recommendations
- candidate A: redwood-raintop-v1-7B-quant (recommended default for throughput/cost balance)
- candidate B: open-re-rank-3B (smaller, lower cost; often better on short candidate lists)
- fallback: redwood-compact-l2 (fast, lower-cost; use in degraded capacity)

What I included (attachments & links)
- prompt sets: 3 slices (head queries, long-tail product queries, and recency-sensitive queries) — file: 20270321-marketplaceai-prompt-sets.csv
- benchmark brief: NDCG / MRR baseline vs. recommended candidates — marketplace-ndcg-mrr-brief.pdf
- A/B runbook draft: ab-runbook.md (traffic split, metrics, monitoring, fallback policy)
- Drive link with raw eval notebooks and sample outputs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-benchmark

Open questions / asks for MarketplaceAI
1) Confirm the canonical sample set (we proposed ~50k Q->candidate lists from last 90 days). If you want a smaller scoped pilot, say 10k, we can still run but power to detect MRR deltas goes down.
2) Latency SLA tolerance: is 95th %-tile 220ms acceptable? You flagged 200ms in the call — we'll show expected impact in the brief.
3) Sign-off on evaluation window: we need 2 weeks of live A/B traffic for stable NDCG estimates given your query volume.

Next steps (proposed)
- You: confirm sample size and SLA tolerance by Tue EOD (23 Mar).
- Us: finalize ab-runbook and instrument dashboards (target Wed 24 Mar).
- Joint: schedule 30 min ops sync to kick off canary (propose Thu 25 Mar).

Let me know if you'd prefer us to run a purely offline eval first (we can) — but given your production traffic profile, a short canary A/B gives the cleanest signal for both NDCG and MRR.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0162

Attachment stubs included: 20270321-marketplaceai-prompt-sets.csv (CSV), marketplace-ndcg-mrr-brief.pdf (PDF), ab-runbook.md (MD)

Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model evaluation package & NDCG/MRR A/B runbook

Hi Priya — answers inline and added more detail on the A/B plan.

Latency expectations
- redwood-raintop-v1-7B-quant: expected p50 ~45ms, p95 ~180-210ms (depending on candidate count; numbers assume 10 candidates).
- open-re-rank-3B: expected p50 ~30ms, p95 ~160-180ms.
- redwood-compact-l2 fallback: p95 < 120ms.

Sample size and statistical power
- For NDCG@10 uplift detection of ~+4.5% absolute we estimate needing ~20k sessions (query+candidate set) for 80% power at alpha=0.05.
- For MRR changes (smaller effect size), the sensitivity is lower; 50k sessions gives decent power to detect medium MRR deltas. This is why we recommended 50k for the primary plan; 10k pilot will give directional signal but may be underpowered for MRR.

Planned A/B run (canary -> full pilot)
- Week 0 (canary): 1% traffic for 48 hours. Metrics: NDCG@10, MRR, p95 latency, CPU/GPU utilization, error rate.
- Week 1–2 (pilot): 20–50% traffic depending on performance & infra; collect aggregate metrics to reach sample targets.
- Fallback policy: automatic rollback to baseline if NDCG drops >1.5% or p95 latency exceeds 250ms for >10 min.

Cost projection
- Estimated incremental inference cost (candidate rerank only): redwood-raintop-v1-7B-quant ~ $0.12 per 1k queries; open-re-rank-3B ~ $0.08 per 1k queries. We will provide precise token counts once you confirm the average candidate list size.

Next actions (from our side)
- I will populate the runbook with the exact metric queries for Redwood Console and a Grafana snapshot for your SREs (target Wed 24 Mar).
- Please confirm sample size and whether you want the pilot to prioritize NDCG sensitivity vs. latency/cost.

Links and artifacts
- Offline eval notebook (sample outputs): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-benchmark
- Brief with detailed per-bucket NDCG/MRR: https://benchmarks.redwood.com/ndcg-mrr/marketplaceai-report

Thanks — happy to jump on a follow up with your ML/Ops team to walk through instrumentation.

Aditya

Attachment stubs included: 20270321-marketplaceai-prompt-sets.csv, ab-runbook.md
